ordinaryPhoto.license: Nomination File; attribution and no derivatives as displayed. Viewed only; no image copied or distributed.
ordinaryPhoto.observed: Actually inspected the ordinary aerial site photograph: rounded eroded earthen mounds, patches of vegetation, drainage/rill patterns and the distant separate shrine/trees. No exposed standing Esagila temple architecture is discernible.

decision: Keep existing native terrain visible. A retained standard DEM surface mesh would duplicate terrain and would not establish a unique authored model of the buried temple; do not count it complete or create a generic temple/ziggurat stand-in. Etemenanki/Tower of Babel is a different mapped site about270m north.
nextRequirement: An explicitly scoped interpretation/display policy for the buried temple, or ordinary visible-reference evidence that supports a specific exposed structure. No bespoke archival/survey research was undertaken.
